description: Removes a recruiting candidate's uploaded resume (candidate_id), as Remove resume does: the file leaves the private bucket and the record's resume is cleared. Upload a new one with upload_candidate_resume. Nothing is sent. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat finds nothing to remove and changes nothing.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: remove_candidate_resume
title: Remove a candidate's resume
